name: @carcolacha/signature-mcp
description: The Visual Cortex as a product — a standalone MCP stdio server giving AI sessions spatial awareness of the rendered Signature Style app: inspect_layout (bounding-rect mapper), audit_contrast (runtime WCAG ratios), audit_e1_shadows (the e1 treaty operationalized), capture_viewport_matrix (4-viewport screenshot sweep). Playwright is pinned EXACTLY to the repo's installed version so the shared Chromium download is reused.
